Every consumer repo's generated `.claude/agents/kwb.md` inherited a first-person `description:` field ("You are inspired by Kent Beck...") instead of the third-person pattern every other agent has, and depending on the generator version, produced a duplicated "You are" in the agent's intro line ("You are Kent B (kwb), You are inspired by..."). Caught by Cursor Bugbot while reviewing punt-labs/beadle#243 (vendoring this registry inline into beadle).

- [x] Read-through against sibling files (kernighan.md, hettinger.md, karpathy.md, mcilroy.md, bernstein.md) confirms the fixed structure matches convention exactly

Docs-only change — Phase 3 verification N/A.

EOF
)" 2>&1
